+@pytest.mark.parametrize("explicit_cause", [True, False])
+def test_application_exception_chain_is_preserved(
+    test_client_factory: TestClientFactory, explicit_cause: bool
+) -> None:
+    cause = RuntimeError("application context")
+
+    async def error_endpoint(_: Request) -> None:
+        if explicit_cause:
+            raise ValueError("application error") from cause
+        try:
+            raise cause
+        except RuntimeError:
+            raise ValueError("application error")
+
+    async def passthrough(request: Request, call_next: RequestResponseEndpoint) -> Response:
+        return await call_next(request)
+
+    app = Starlette(
+        middleware=[Middleware(BaseHTTPMiddleware, dispatch=passthrough)],
+        routes=[Route("/", error_endpoint)],
+    )
+
+    with test_client_factory(app) as client, pytest.raises(ValueError) as exc_info:
+        client.get("/")
+
+    if explicit_cause:
+        assert exc_info.value.__cause__ is cause
+    else:
+        assert exc_info.value.__context__ is cause
+
+
